name: Voyager 1
_about: Voyager 1: launch 5 Sep 1977 12:56 UTC (Titan IIIE-Centaur, Cape Canaveral LC-41); Jupiter closest approach 5 Mar 1979 12:05 UTC (~349,000 km from the centre); Titan closest approach 12 Nov 1980 05:41 UTC; Saturn closest approach 12 Nov 1980 23:46 UTC; Pale Blue Dot 14 Feb 1990; termination shock 16 Dec 2004 at ~94 AU; heliopause 25 Aug 2012 at ~122 AU (NASA/JPL). Trajectory: JPL Horizons target -31, heliocentric ICRF vectors, sampled hourly round the encounters and every 60 days after 1981 (fetched 2026-10-08). Horizons' own notes: before 1981 a patched-conic reconstruction matched to the encounters ('rough accuracy'); from 1981 a 2022 refit of the 1981-1992 tracking data. The launch point at 12:56 is placed on Launch Complex 41 (28.583 N, 80.583 W) at that moment; Horizons starts at 13:59.
